name: stackadapt-mcp
description: StackAdapt (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_stackadapt_rest_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_STACKADAPT_REST_API_KEY
platform_mcp_stackadapt_rest_api_key.description: StackAdapt REST API key (issued by StackAdapt on request), sent as the X-Authorization header. The GraphQL API uses a different Bearer token and is not used here.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no user endpoint in the REST API; the probe is GET /advertisers (advertisers the key can access). REST spec: https://www.stackadapt.com/service/v2/apidocs.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /advertisers: first page (30 per page) of the advertisers the key can access; total_advertisers gives the full count.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /campaigns?page=N (30 per page): every campaign the key can access, across advertisers; `account_id` is NOT applied as a filter (advertiser_id is on each row). state is active or paused (status.code/description in raw); `budget` is the campaign budget and daily_cap the daily limit (raw). `status` and `limit` are not sent.
